definitions: To make something look more attractive by adding ornaments or embellishments.
To apply paint, wallpaper, or other coverings to the walls and ceilings of a room or building.
To confer an award or medal upon someone as an honor.
examples: They decided to decorate the Christmas tree with lights and tinsel.
We hired a professional to decorate the interior of our new house.
The general was decorated for his bravery in battle.
